programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Invincible! A Gruesome Army of Headcracker Dolls!
programme.desc: Robin, Rebecca, and Bartolomeo draw closer to the Flower Field on the fourth level of the Royal Palace plateau, but a sudden attack by Gladius' exploding spheres sends Robin and Bartolomeo hurtling towards the level below.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Risking Their Lives! Luffy is the Trump Card for Victory!
programme.desc: Rebecca makes it to the Flower Field alone, but unfortunately finds company there that is less than friendly! Meanwhile, Bartolomeo pushes himself to the limit in order to help Luffy advance, but does he leave himself vulnerable in the process?

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: A Tearful Reunion! Rebecca and Kyros!
programme.desc: Diamante has Rebecca pinned and completely overpowered. If only the Soldier-san of her youth were able to protect her! Meanwhile, Luffy and Law finally surmount incredible odds to land themselves in striking distance of Doflamingo.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: One Shot One Kill! The Man Who Will Save Dressrosa!
programme.desc: Usopp uses Viola's Clairvoyance to prepare his ammunition to take Sugar out! But the slightest hesitation now will spell disaster, and the end of Luffy! Luckily for the Straw Hats, Usopp's ammunition has been specially designed for this situation!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Anger Erupts! Luffy and Law's Ultimate Stratagem!
programme.desc: The final showdown with Doflamingo begins, but the Warlord still has several tricks up his sleeve - including turning one of Luffy's own friends against him! Meanwhile Franky and Señor Pink are in a standoff to find out who is the coolest.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: A Noble Family! The True Identity of Doflamingo!
programme.desc: All hopes rest on Luffy and Law being able to take down Doflamingo; but the Warlord has other plans in mind as he gives the two the fight of their lives, and reveals his true, shocking history! Meanwhile, Sabo finds out Fujitora's true intention…

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: The Ultimate Power! The Secret of the Op-Op Fruit!
programme.desc: With Fujitora's stalemate arousing suspicion in the Navy ranks, Law and Luffy stand seconds away from execution at the hand of Doflamingo! But before he dispatches them both, he shares the secret of his sway over the Celestial Dragons!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Sad Memories! Law, the Boy from the White Town!
programme.desc: The horrible secret of Flevance, the White Town, is revealed, giving clues to Law's traumatic past! A rage born from the lies of the World Government created a child who had the will to kill Corazon!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: A Celestial Dragon! Doffy's Stormy Past!
programme.desc: Law's attack on Corazon looks less successful than he thought! And after he's accepted into the Doflamingo Family, Corazon's mysterious silence hides a fact that may save Law's life - and a hidden danger Law must face in Doflamingo himself!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: A Rocky Road! Law and Corazon's Journey of Life!
programme.desc: Things grow stranger for Law as he learns the secret behind why Corazon feigns being mute! But the mysterious Corazon's actions are only beginning to baffle Law as he takes him on a journey to cure his White Lead Disease.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: The Time is Ticking Down! Seize the Op-Op Fruit!
programme.desc: Corazon's double-dealing with the Navy raises suspicions both with Doflamingo and Law. But all that is secondary as Corazon finally has a chance to grab the Op-Op Fruit during a staged handoff arranged by the Government.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: The Moment of Resolution! Corazon's Farewell Smile!
programme.desc: The Op-Op Fruit is in Corazon's hands! But the price he paid to get it might be too high... When Law goes for help, unfortunate coincidences intervene and leave the two vulnerable! Meanwhile, Doflamingo and his clan finally land at Minion Island.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Advance, Law! The Kindhearted Man's Final Fight!
programme.desc: Doflamingo & his Family begin to zero in on Corazon and Law's whereabouts, but Corazon has a plan to hide Law long enough to let him escape, even if that means sacrificing his own life. A chain of lucky coincidences allows the plan to be set into motion.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: To Be Free! Law's Injection Shot Blasts!
programme.desc: Violet runs down the status of the open battles raging in Dressrosa - the Straw Hats, the Tontattas, the executives of the Doflamingo Family - all of them clash around the island, but it's Law's revelation to Doflamingo that moves the action forward!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: An Intense Battle! Law vs. Doflamingo!
programme.desc: Luffy continues to battle Fake-mingo, but keeps accidentally battling Bellamy instead. Meanwhile the tide of battle turns against Law as painful scars from the past resurface. And Zoro gets unexpected help in his battle with Pica.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: A Decisive Battle Against the Executives! Proud Hajrudin!
programme.desc: Bellamy escapes Doflamingo's control, but it might be too late. His long history with Doflamingo unfolds and leads to an inglorious end. Meanwhile, Hajrudin has been beaten down, but a fire still burns in him to pay back the favor he owes!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: The Battle of Love! The New Leader Sai vs. Baby 5!
programme.desc: Lao G and Don Chinjao duke it out as each brings their most devastating attacks to the battle. But a misunderstanding caused by Baby 5 has Sai and Don Chinjao distracted - are they distracted enough for Lao G to gain the upper hand?

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: The Man's Pride! Bellamy's Last Charge!
programme.desc: Law is at the whim of Doflamingo and Trebol, while Luffy still has to deal with Bellamy, who fights to keep his honor even after being released by Doflamingo! Meanwhile, Gladius is about to detonate the ground around Cavendish and Bartolomeo!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: A Strong Wind and a Surge! Hakuba vs. Dellinger!
programme.desc: A mysterious force that resembles Cavendish menaces the battlefield - but while it appears to help Bartolomeo and the others at first, it sets its sights on Robin! Meanwhile, the deeply-wounded Ideo sees Dellinger's horrible true nature!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Bartolomeo is in a neck-and-neck battle against Gladius to save Robin, and is faced with an impossible dilemma. With all his options leading to their defeat, can his cunning ploy save the day? Meanwhile, Robin is face to face with Cavendish.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Princess Mansherry's amazing power - to heal living beings completely - is in the hands of the Donquixote executive. If she is able to heal all the executives who've gone down in battle - the Straw Hats and their allies stand no chance!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: The Manly Duel! Señor's Elegy of Love!
programme.desc: Señor Pink and Franky continue their knock-down, drag-out, manly fight. As both of them are pushed to their limits, we learn Señor's tragic past! Meanwhile, Princess Mansherry's rescue hits a snag as she stubbornly refuses to leave!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Stardust of Death! Diamante's Storm of Vicious Attacks!
programme.desc: Franky and Señor Pink end their harrowing duel in a manly way - but victory knocks the wind out of even the winner's sails! Meanwhile, Diamante and Kyros struggle desperately on the Sunflower Field, each demonstrating their extreme prowess.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Kyros, unbowed by Diamante's vicious attacks, fights back with the anger and retribution of all of Dressrosa in order to fulfill his promise to protect Rebecca. If he is successful, only a few executives will remain.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Moving Across the Ground! The Giant Statue Pica's Surprise Maneuver!
programme.desc: Pica loses his temper and turns his full wrath against King Riku, whom he hopes to destroy, ending the revolution against Doflamingo. Meanwhile, Zoro, who has been distracted by Pica and drawn far from the battle, has to hatch a plan to save the king!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: A Decisive Battle in Midair! Zoro's New Special Secret Technique Blasts!
programme.desc: With the lives of King Riku, Usopp, and the others on the old King's Plateau in the balance, Zoro must dig deep and discover a powerful technique to counter Pica's near-unstoppable onslaught. Meanwhile, King Riku ponders what it means to be a good king.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Zoro finishes off Pica, and those below his crumbling body rush to find shelter. Meanwhile, the Tontattas finish up demolishing the SMILE Factory, and Luffy's hand is forced in his duel with Bellamy!

programme.title: On the Case: A Wave Goodbye
programme.desc: A 14-year-old girl is discovered murdered at an empty campground, located more than 50 miles from where she was last sighted.

programme.title: On the Case: One Month of Terror
programme.desc: After abducting a 17 year old girl in front of her home her kidnapper taunts the family with phone calls and disturbing letters. But a tiny mistake will eventually lead police to his door.

programme.title: On the Case: A Complicated Relationship
programme.desc: A beloved mother of four disappears just days after her stepdaughter vanished. Police must investigate to find out if their complicated relationship led to tragedy.

programme.title: On the Case: Unanswered Questions
programme.desc: Patti Berry disappears on the way to pick up her child at the babysitter's, then her body is found in a secluded wooded area not far from her abandoned blood-soaked car.

programme.title: On the Case: Gone in an Instant
programme.desc: In Lenexa, Kansas, young women disappear from their apartments as police piece together evidence showing the terrifying crimes are connected.

programme.title: On the Case: A Test of Patience
programme.desc: The unsolved murder of a teenager torments a small midwestern city for decades until a relentless team of investigators finally finds the clue that breaks the case wide open.

programme.title: On the Case: Scent of a Killer
programme.desc: The investigation into Sandra Iverson's stabbing death goes cold until a police canine team uncovers a trail leading them to an unlikely young suspect.

programme.title: On the Case: Shortcut to Murder
programme.desc: Paula Zahn goes beyond the headlines in search of fascinating mysteries from within America's justice system. A shortcut home from school causes a 14-year-old girl to cross paths with a murderer.

programme.title: On the Case: A Call for Justice
programme.desc: After a man confesses to a terrible double homicide, police must determine whether he actually committed the crime.

programme.title: On the Case: No One To Trust
programme.desc: A beautiful young girl vanishes on a desolate stretch of highway. Could the man in charge of the investigation be responsible?

programme.title: On the Case: Follow the Footprints
programme.desc: When a young girl's lifeless body turns up on the shore of the Feather River, police hope that following a trail of footsteps and discarded articles of clothing will lead them to her killer.

programme.title: On the Case: The Long Path to Justice
programme.desc: A couple's daily walk ends in murder and a cloud of suspicion descends on the victim's family.

programme.title: On the Case: A Dream Shattered
programme.desc: When a young teacher fails to show up for work, her principal goes looking for her at her home, where he makes a shocking discovery. The case would go cold until DNA technology helps police track down her killer.

programme.title: On the Case: Desperate Cry
programme.desc: A mother's desperate cry for help alerts neighbors and leads to a terrifying discovery.

programme.title: On the Case: Murder At Sunset- Part 1
programme.desc: A mother and two daughters are discovered floating in Tampa Bay after a brutal triple homicide. Police must rely on a victim who survived a similar attack to bring the killer to justice in this special two-hour On The Case.

programme.title: Sabrina The Teenage Witch

programme.desc: La storia mai raccontata di Diego Armando Maradona, il più grande calciatore di tutti i tempi. Il documentario ripercorre la sua vita e morte attraverso filmati inediti, svelando virtù, vizi e violenze del fuoriclasse.

programme.title: Nadia Comaneci Sport e potere
programme.desc: Alle Olimpiadi di Montreal 1976, Nadia Comăneci, a soli 14 anni, ottiene il primo 10 perfetto nella ginnastica artistica, diventando icona mondiale. La sua grazia e talento affascinano milioni e la elevano a simbolo di eccellenza sportiva e culturale.

programme.title: Cristiano Ronaldo: Il mondo ai suoi piedi
programme.desc: Un documentario sul campione Cristiano Ronaldo, che ne ripercorre la carriera, dagli esordi in Portogallo agli anni straordinari trascorsi nel Real Madrid e nel Manchester United.

programme.title: Jacques Cousteaus Legacy
programme.desc: This film reconstructs the life of famed marine biologist and environmental pioneer Jacques Cousteau using a fascinating mix of wildlife footage, archive material and elaborate reenactments.

programme.title: Return of the Bible Plagues: Locusts
programme.desc: Swarms of locusts are still a very real plague today. They afflict drought areas, especially after a rare rainfall, leaving a trail of destruction behind.

programme.title: My Family and The Galapagos: Episode 1
programme.desc: Biologist broadcaster and conservationist Monty Halls and his family go to the Galapagos Islands, where for the next three months they will experience an utterly unique way of life.

programme.title: Museum Secrets: Inside the Israel Museum, Jerusalem
programme.desc: From a scientist who recreates the crucifixion to an ancient amulet that proves Star Trek's Spock is Jewish, discover the secrets inside the Israel Museum.

programme.title: WWII's The Great Escapes: The Freedom Trails: France and Spain: The Pyrenees
programme.desc: Monty treks one of the toughest and most famous freedom trails out of Nazi controlled France, taking him through the valleys and high ridges of the Pyrenees mountains and into Spain.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gravity
programme.desc: This film features unexpected historical insights, cutting-edge science and exciting new experiments. From Einstein's Relativity to quantum mechanics, host Jim Al-Khalili explores one of the most extraordinary phenomena in our universe.

programme.title: Myths & Monsters: Change & Revolution
programme.desc: How does a community form? How does it survive and adapt to change? This episode details the role myths and legends have played in establishing the rules of society and the punishments for those who break them.

programme.title: How The Beatles Changed The World
programme.desc: A fascinating story of the cultural, social, spiritual and musical revolution that was ignited by The Beatles, with revealing interviews and rarely-seen archival footage of the band.

programme.title: Lebron James - King of The Court
programme.desc: The NBA star showed promise in high school, before going on to make a name for himself as an all time great.

programme.title: Art of the Heist: Chasing Cezanne
programme.desc: Nearly thirty years ago seven paintings, including a priceless Cezanne, were stolen from a private collection in America. As the years passed, Michael Bakwin, who owned the paintings, though he would never get see his precious Cezanne again.

programme.title: The Mind of the Universe: The Conqueror
programme.desc: Humankind conquered the world, in order to survive, and conquers his fellow humans with new ideas. We will see how we as a species have conquered the earth, how we still compete with viruses, and how quantum theory conquers China.

programme.title: Sparkling: The Story of Champagne
programme.desc: En berusende kærlighedserklæring til den sprudlende glæde og fornøjelse det er at nyde champagne og engelsk mousserende vin! Historien går helt tilbage til den franske munk Dom Perignon, der ved et tilfælde opfandt champagnen.

programme.title: A Time to Kill
programme.desc: Old ways die hard. It's the lesson learned by Carl Lee Hailey, a Mississippi factory worker, when two racist thugs brutally assault his ten-year-old daughter on a drunken spree.

programme.title: The Social Network
programme.desc: The film focuses on the evolution of Facebook, the online social network created in 2004 on the Harvard campus, and how overnight success and wealth changed the lives of the classmates who created it.

programme.title: Burlesque
programme.desc: A small-town singer moves to the big city for her chance at stardom when she discovers Burlesque, a glamorous nightclub packed with dancers, sizzling musical numbers, and an owner in need of a star.

programme.title: A Star Is Born
programme.desc: In this new take on the tragic love story, musician Jackson Maine discovers—and falls in love with—struggling artist Ally. But even as Ally's career takes off, their relationship is breaking down.

programme.title: Dreamgirls
programme.desc: With showstopping performances by a star-studded cast, Dreamgirls soars with the amazing story of three female singers who learn that anything is possible when you hold on to your dreams.

programme.title: The Meddler
programme.desc: After the death of her husband, a woman (Oscar winner Susan Sarandon) moves from New Jersey to Los Angeles to be closer to her daughter (Rose Byrne).

programme.title: Living
programme.desc: Bill Nighy stars as a humorless bureaucrat in 1950s London who decides to take time off work to experience life following a grim diagnosis.

programme.title: Borg vs. McEnroe
programme.desc: The story of the legendary 1980s tennis rivalry between the placid Björn Borg (Sverrir Gudnason) and the volatile John McEnroe (Shia LaBeouf).

programme.title: I, Tonya
programme.desc: Competitive ice skater Tonya Harding rises amongst the ranks at the U.S. Figure Skating Championships, but her future in the activity is thrown into doubt when her ex-husband intervenes.

programme.title: The Founder
programme.desc: The true story of Ray Kroc, a salesman who turned two brothers' innovative fast food eatery, McDonald's, into one of the biggest restaurant businesses in the world.

programme.title: Whiplash
programme.desc: In this triple Oscar-winning film, a young drummer (Miles Teller) in his school's top-tier jazz band clashes with the intense, abusive methods of an obsessive music teacher (J.K. Simmons). With Melissa Benoist.

programme.desc: Meiji Kinenkan es la sala nupcial más antigua de Japón que se está renovando para celebrar su 50 aniversario. Esto incluye la adición de un restaurante chino y su nuevo gran chef.

programme.desc: Adolescente descobre ter poderes de teletransporte. Viajando com o poder da mente procura o responsável pela morte da mãe. O governo o descobre. Eles sabem de um menino com o mesmo poder.

programme.title: Ragnarok
programme.desc: Um arqueólogo fica obcecado pelos escritos encontrados em um navio viking, que podem solucionar o mistério de Ragnarok Porém, durante suas buscas, ele acaba despertando acidentalmente um monstro gigantesco.

programme.title: Os Caçadores de Relíquias
programme.desc: Hu Bayi e Fatty estão ajudando Shirley Yang a encontrar o Roteiro Quilha na Gruta Long Ling para tratar uma doença estranha. Eles enfrentam desafios como o rei dragão de cabeça de ferro, túmulos armadilhados, lobos e aranhas gigantes.

programme.title: Era uma vez na China e na América
programme.desc: Jet Li é Wong Fei-Hong, herói chinês que vai à América, é salvo por índios e luta contra a exploração de trabalhadores chineses por um tirano local.

programme.title: Retroceder Nunca, Render-se Jamais
programme.desc: Jason Stillwell é um fã de Bruce Lee e jovem aprendiz de artes marciais. Após seu pai negar participar de uma gangue de criminosos, eles se mudam de cidade, onde Jason encontrará problemas.

programme.title: Hitman - O Rei dos Assassinos
programme.desc: Um antigo chefe da máfia japonesa suspeita de ser vítima de um ataque e deixa uma recompensa para a pessoa que encontrar o seu assassino.

programme.title: A Hora do Acerto
programme.desc: Para a Gangue dos 5, tudo é um videogame: matar policiais, armar emboscadas e criar requintes de crueldade. Quem se torna vítima de suas armadilhas é o inspetor de polícia Wing e todo o seu time de policiais, que são brutalmente assassinados.

programme.title: Era uma vez na China 3
programme.desc: Mestre Wong e seus discípulos entram na 'Competição de Leão Dançante' para deter um plano de assassinato e enfrentar um oponente arrogante.

programme.title: Olhos de Dragão
programme.desc: Hong usa sua visão moral e habilidades para lutar e salvar um bairro de traficantes de drogas e policiais corruptos.

programme.title: Alaska
programme.desc: Anos após se separarem, Ana e Fernando decidem visitar mais uma vez a Chapada dos Veadeiros, que foi cenário de uma intensa história de amor entre os dois. A viagem é uma segunda chance para essa paixão.

programme.title: Mussum, Um Filme do Cacildis
programme.desc: A trajetória do humorista e sambista Antônio Carlos Bernado Gomes, o "Mussum", é contada de diferentes ângulos.

programme.title: A Casa Verde
programme.desc: Cientista inventa máquina de reciclar lixo, mas é perseguido por vilão poluidor.

programme.title: Dona Flor E Seus Dois Maridos
programme.desc: Baseado no livro de Jorge Amado, o filme conta a história de Flor que, ao ficar viúva do fanfarrão Vadinho, casa-se com o correto e metódico Dr. Teobaldo. Com saudades do fogo de Vadinho, Flor conjura a alma do ex-marido e passa a viver com os dois.

programme.title: Ela Disse, Ele Disse
programme.desc: Rosa e Léo são adolescentes de 14 anos que acabaram de entrar em uma escola onde precisam lidar com a tarefa de fazer amigos. Enquanto Léo logo demonstra interesse em futebol Rosa enfrenta problemas com a garota mais popular do colégio.

programme.title: A Bruta Flor do Querer
programme.desc: "Ousado, criativo e visceral" L.C. Merten - O Estado de São Paulo. Diego, um recém formado em cinema, se vê obrigado a trabalhar como cameraman de casamentos.

programme.title: A Musa Impassível
programme.desc: Adrine tem TOC e aspira à imobilidade, Edivaldo tem ausências que o paralisam completamente. Numa manhã, as vidas de Edivaldo e Adrine se cruzam na região da Luz por causa de uma laranja quase madura.

programme.title: Desaparecidos
programme.desc: Em outubro de 2011 uma festa particular em Ilhabela pode ter sido o último destino de seis jovens. O convite entregue a eles vinha acompanhado por uma câmera filmadora, que deveria ser utilizada o tempo todo para registrar imagens aleatórias da diversão.

programme.title: All She Wishes
programme.desc: Quando il suo desiderio di compleanno evoca magicamente il bizzarro attore hollywoodiano Drake (19) nella sua piccola città del Midwest, la diciottenne Sophie deve aiutarlo ad ambientarsi fino a quando non riuscirà a riportarlo a casa.

programme.title: Per te, con amore
programme.desc: Il proprietario di un negozio di abiti da sposa di seconda mano dà nuova vita agli abiti usati, realizzando i sogni delle spose che non possono permettersi abiti costosi.

programme.title: Semplicemente irresistibile
programme.desc: Un proprietario di un ristorante e un importante direttore di un grande magazzino si incontrano al mercato e, con un pizzico di magia, qualcosa sta per cambiare nelle loro vite.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled
programme.desc: Una cantante country torna nella sua piccola città natale una settimana prima del matrimonio, solo per scoprire che potrebbe esserci ancora una scintilla tra lei e il suo amore del liceo.

programme.title: Mozart and the whale
programme.desc: Donald e Isabel sono affetti dalla sindrome di Asperger. Gli stravolgerà la vita e lui non potrà che innamorarsene perdutamente.

programme.title: Semplicemente irresistibile
programme.desc: Un proprietario di un ristorante e un importante direttore di un grande magazzino si incontrano al mercato e, con un pizzico di magia, qualcosa sta per cambiare nelle loro vite.

programme.title: Un marito da addestrare
programme.desc: In questa divertente commedia romantica diretta da Sandra L. Martin, Julie Gonzalo (A Cinderella Story) veste i panni di Jilian, affermata scrittrice e consulente matrimoniale la cui vita sentimentale è in profonda crisi.

programme.title: Due cuori e una baita
programme.desc: Workaholic Jillian plants to sell an inherited mountainside cabin, but a handsome caretaker Liam makes an offer. Sparks fly as they transform the cabin into a holiday resort. But when business doesn’t go to plan, will Jillian give up everything for love?

programme.title: Le Due vie del Destino
programme.desc: Con Colin Firth e Nicole Kidman, la vera storia di Eric Lomax, ex ufficiale inglese torturato dai giapponesi nel 1942 durante la costruzione della “ferrovia della morte”. Anni dopo scopre che uno dei suoi aguzzini è vivo e parte alla ricerca di vendetta.

programme.title: Berlino: Opzione Zero
programme.desc: Berlino, 1978. Un sostituto procuratore americano, Herbert J. Stern, viene chiamato a giudicare sulla legittimità dell'operato di un tedesco che, con la complicità di una donna, ha dirottato un aereo da Berlino Est a Berlino Ovest.

programme.title: Otzi - L'ultimo cacciatore
programme.desc: Neolitico. Il clan guidato da Otzi viene attaccato per sottrarre uno scrigno contente un oggetto sacro. Rientrato all'accampamento, trova i membri della tribù brutalmente assassinati. Accecato dal dolore e dalla rabbia, ha un unico obiettivo: la vendetta!

programme.title: Il re vichingo
programme.desc: Europa del Nord, XIIIsec. Il crociato Max von Buxhoveden vuole distruggere le credenze pagane dei popoli del nord. La resa sembra cosa fatta quando in punto di morte il re cede il suo anello, simbolo del potere, al nipote Namejs cresciuto tra i cristiani.

programme.title: Dovbush - Il Guerriero della montagna
programme.desc: XVIII secolo. Nei Carpazi, sotto il dominio straniero, i fratelli Dovbush diventano fuorilegge leggendari. Ma l'avidità divide i loro destini: Oleksa sceglie la libertà del popolo, suo fratello solo il denaro.

programme.title: The Pirate
programme.desc: Il pirata greco che divenne uomo d'affari, Ioannis Varvakis, fece fortuna vendendo caviale in Russia e in tutto il mondo. Varvakis lotta per tutta la vita per la libertà per se stesso e poi per il suo paese...

programme.title: Bent
programme.desc: Nella Berlino degli anni '30, un ebreo gay viene mandato in un campo di concentramento sotto il regime nazista.

programme.title: Bad blood - Debito di sangue
programme.desc: Hannah è bionda, carina e incastrata in una vita buia e sporca, fatta di droghe, spaccio e illegalità in tutte le sue declinazioni. Sulle sue spalle, grava la responsabilità dell'intera famiglia, coinvolta in affari illeciti e amori impossibili.

programme.title: Lo straniero
programme.desc: L'ispettore Wilson è incaricato di rintracciare il criminale nazista Franz Kindler negli Stati Uniti. I suoi sospetti si concentrano sul professor Rankin, stimato e tranquillo insegnante, fidanzato con Mary, la figlia di un giudice della Corte Suprema.

programme.title: Fatal Instinct
programme.desc: Il fratello di un ispettore di polizia figura fra i principali sospettati di una serie di omicidi a Los Angeles.

programme.title: Blue Steel: Bersaglio Mortale
programme.desc: Una recluta nelle forze di polizia si ritrova a giocare al gatto e al topo con uno psicopatico armato di pistola che diventa ossessionato da lei.

programme.title: Rapimento in diretta
programme.desc: Intenso e appassionante thriller con protagonista Kim Shaw nei panni di Sacha Bruder, un'aspirante giornalista di punta. Facendosi strada in una tv locale, Sacha copre gli eventi della comunità, ma aspira a occuparsi di storie ben più importanti.

programme.title: Gamer
programme.desc: In un futuro gioco di controllo mentale, i condannati a morte sono costretti a combattere in un ambiente senza speranza. Il condannato Kable è controllato da Simon e deve sopravvivere a trenta sessioni per essere liberato.

programme.title: The Informers - Vite oltre il limite
programme.desc: Dal libro “Acqua dal sole” di Bret Easton Ellis. Una settimana nella frenetica Los Angeles del 1983 in compagnia di attori, rock star, un vampiro e altri personaggi moralmente discutibili in una storia fatta di lussuria, droga e violenza.

programme.title: Fuga da Pretoria
programme.desc: Arrestati per aver partecipato ad operazioni segrete per conto dell'African National Congress di Nelson Mandela, due attivisti sudafricani cercano di inviare un messaggio al regime dell'apartheid e fuggire dalla famigerata prigione di Pretoria.

programme.title: Chez Maupassant: L'assassin
programme.desc: Monsieur Caravan, commis principal au Ministère de la Marine, habite Courbevoie, avec sa femme et sa vieille mère. Celle-ci meurt subitement. Le docteur Chenet vient constater le décès.

programme.title: Le Pays des enfants perdus
programme.desc: Dans les années 60, après une décision administrative, les autorités décident de transférer de jeunes réunionnais vers la région de la Creuse, pour contrecarrer l'exode rural et la dénatalité.

programme.title: Contes et nouvelles du XIXème siècle: Un gentilhomme
programme.desc: Un jeune écrivain dans le dénuement, Charles Varnat, trouve enfin un emploi dans un château normand, comme secrétaire particulier d’un gentilhomme, le marquis d'Amblezy-Serac.

programme.title: Contes et nouvelles du XIXème siècle: Aimé de son concierge
programme.desc: Le comte de Frontac, riche propriétaire en Languedoc, a été ruiné et assassiné. Les enquêteurs ont conclu à des imprudences financières et un suicide. Son fils, Clovis, un artiste dessinateur, n’est pas de cet avis.

programme.title: Contes et nouvelles du XIXème siècle: On purge bébé
programme.desc: Follavoine, fabricant de porcelaine, a mis au point un pot de chambre incassable et compte bien remporter le contrat d’exclusivité pour l’Armée française.

programme.title: D'artagnan
programme.desc: Le roman d'Alexandre Dumas est mis à jour avec une influence orientale. D'Artagnan tente de rejoindre les gardes d'élite du roi, les mousquetaires royaux et de trouver le meurtrier de ses parents.

programme.title: Accusé: L'histoire d’Hélène
programme.desc: Juliette et Laurent s’étreignent ardemment, se rhabillent à la hâte, et enfourchent leur moto. Ils sont pressés... Aujourd’hui, ils se marient. Leur famille et amis les attendent à la mairie. Sur leur bolide, ils fendent l’air et se sentent invincibles...

programme.title: Accusé: L'histoire de Laurent
programme.desc: Libérée et célibataire assumée, Claire est inscrite sur un site de rencontres. Depuis plusieurs mois, elle discute en ligne avec un bel inconnu. Rodée à ce genre d’échanges, cette fois, elle a vraiment le sentiment d’être tombée sur la perle rare.

programme.title: Chez Maupassant: Histoire d'une Fille de ferme
programme.desc: Rose, une fille de la ferme, est amoureuse d'un saisonnier. Très vite, la jeune femme tombe enceinte mais son galant préfère s'enfuir plutôt que d'assumer la paternité. Rose cache sa grossesse.

programme.title: Chez Maupassant: La Parure
programme.desc: Rêvant de faste et de luxe la femme d’un employé de ministère emprunte à une amie fortunée une rivière de diamants pour une soirée. Au retour elle la perd. N’en disant rien, le couple se ruine alors pour remplacer la parure à l’identique.

programme.title: Historia del automóvil: AMG
programme.desc: AMG siempre ha sido sinónimo de excelencia automovilística, exclusividad y dinamismo al conducir.

programme.title: Historia del automóvil: Lancia
programme.desc: Vehículos excepcionales y éxitos legendarios en el mundo del motor por un lado, golpes del destino y errores económicos por el otro.

programme.title: Historia del automóvil: BMW M
programme.desc: La división de automovilismo de BMW ha sido una historia de éxito desde su creación. Y no sólo en la pista. Los coches de carretera con la letra M en la parte trasera fascinan a todo el mundo.

programme.title: Historia del automóvil: Renault
programme.desc: Vive la diferencia: Siempre extraordinarios en el diseño, siempre inusuales en el confort del motor, a menudo vanguardistas: los coches de la marca Renault.

programme.title: Classic Ride: Días de vino y rosas de los coches clásicos
programme.sub-title: Días de vino y rosas de los coches clásicos
programme.desc: El F12 Roadster de 1964 fue el canto del cisne de DKW, pues fue el último vehículo bajo el nombre de la marca tradicional antes de que se fusionara con otras empresas bajo el nombre de Auto Union.

programme.title: Classic Ride: Leyendas del Rally
programme.desc: En los 80 apareció una nueva y efímera clase en los rallies de coches: el Grupo B. Los vehículos turboalimentados con hasta 500 hp conquistaron las pistas de rallye internacionales, lo que dio lugar a varios accidentes mortales.

programme.title: Classic Ride: Los coches clásicos alemanes de los años 70
programme.sub-title: Los coches clásicos alemanes de los años 70
programme.desc: En la década de 1970 los modelos W 114/115 de Mercedes ofrecían una sólida tecnología a precios asequibles, lo que hizo que el sedán estilo Paul Braq se convirtiera en el primer Mercedes para la gente corriente.

programme.title: Classic Ride: La movilidad en Europa del Este
programme.sub-title: La movilidad en Europa del Este
programme.desc: Cabe pensar que en la época comunista de Europa del Este solo había coches como el Trabant, el Wartburg o el Lada. Sin embargo, compañías como Tatra de Checoslovaquia introdujeron automóviles avanzados, incluso pioneros.

programme.title: Los Novatos: El duro camino hacia la Pole Position
programme.desc: La guardería del piloto de carreras es la pista de karts. Independientemente de si Vettel, Schumi o Hamilton, todos empezaron pequeños. En Newcomer acompañamos a los jóvenes del automovilismo en el duro y difícil camino hacia la pole position.

programme.title: Los Novatos: El duro camino hacia la Pole Position
programme.desc: Es el sueño de cientos de jóvenes: una carrera como piloto de carreras. Independientemente de si es Fórmula 3 o Campeonato Alemán de Kart. El camino hacia la cima solo conduce a través de buenos resultados y el dinero.

programme.title: Los Novatos: El duro camino hacia la Pole Position
programme.desc: Carrie Schreiner no es la típica chica de 14 años. La joven mujer del Sarre va camino de convertirse en una profesional de las carreras. Le espera un duro entrenamiento para hacer realidad su sueño. Y los pilotos de Fórmula 3 también tienen que entrenar.

programme.title: Los Novatos: El duro camino hacia la Pole Position
programme.desc: El trabajo como piloto de carreras es emocionante, viajas mucho y la mayoría lo admira: ¡un trabajo de ensueño! Pero el camino hacia las carreras es duro. Todo el mundo en el Campeonato de Europa de Fórmula 3 lo sabe.

programme.title: Los Novatos: El duro camino hacia la Pole Position
programme.desc: Ya sean carreras de karts o Fórmula 3. Los jóvenes del automovilismo en Alemania van regularmente a la pista de carreras. Pero no hay carrera sin los padres, solo se puede avanzar con el apoyo familiar.

programme.title: Los Novatos: El duro camino hacia la Pole Position
programme.desc: Carrie Schreiner está a punto de pasar a la siguiente clase. Y esta vez da un salto de gigante: del kart al coche de fórmula. Se le permite conducir un auto de fórmula real por primera vez y prueba los límites del velocista de 200 hp.

programme.title: Classic Ride: Descapotables potentes
programme.desc: El Porsche 911 Targa es un clásico y un buen ejemplo de descapotable emblemático. Y además: el ligero Lotus Seven Twin Cam SS es más para una carrera que un vehículo de carretera normal; el Bentley de 1930 de 4,5 litros Bentley es el Santo Grial…

programme.title: MotorStories: SEMA, Las Vegas - Parte 1
programme.desc: Cada año 150.000 amantes del motor viajan al desierto de Navada para asistir al SEMA de Las Vegas, la más célebre exposición de automóviles tuneados del mundo. Entre ellos está la periodista Kati que se reúne con el experto en tuneo Dirk Hattenh.

programme.title: MotorStories: SEMA, Las Vegas - Parte 2
programme.desc: El SEMA Show de Las Vegas es la mayor y más conocida exposición de automóviles personalizados del mundo. Todo está presente, desde los coches de exhibición reconstruidos de forma compleja hasta los gigantescos 4x4.

programme.title: MotorStories: Personalización de la moto LA
programme.desc: No hay nada más estimulante para Ola Stenegard, diseñador de motos BMW, que viajar por California. Allí conocerá a leyendas de fama mundial como el diseñador Ronald Sands o los customizadores Michel "Wooley" Woolaway y Alan Stulberg.

programme.title: Superautos: Porsche 911
programme.desc: El Porsche 911 presenta un estilo modesto como ningún otro coche deportivo en el mundo. No presume, evitando cualquier apariencia estridente, y antepone la forma a la función.

programme.title: Superautos: BMW i8
programme.desc: Con el i8, BMW fue el único fabricante alemán de automóviles de gran volumen que cambió su visión del futuro creando un deportivo totalmente futurista.

programme.title: Superautos: Estilos de vida SUV
programme.desc: El desierto, un horizonte sin fin, montañas verdes y colinas escarpadas. En Marruecos se pueden encontrar los paisajes de ensueño de las mil y una noches.

programme.title: Superautos: Porsche Cayman GTS
programme.desc: Conducir el Porsche Cayman GTS es como montar en una bala: una emoción constante pero en un entorno controlado. En la soleada isla de Mallorca hicimos que esta divertida máquina subiera colinas y se enfrentara a una pista de carreras.

programme.title: Superautos: Primera clase para ingresos altos
programme.desc: El coupé de alto rendimiento RS7 Sportback de Audi combina hábilmente lujo y potencia, mientras que la Clase S de Mercedes siempre ha sido considerada como una referencia en el sector del lujo.

programme.title: Uma Robô Adolescente
programme.sub-title: O mundo maravilhoso de Wizzly / A super mãe
programme.desc: Jenny vai ao parque de diversão e, ao ver que os robôs do local são maltratados, ela liberta todos eles. / Quando Jenny deixa de atender as ligações de Wakeman, a doutora se vê obrigada a tomar medidas drásticas.

programme.title: Uma Robô Adolescente
programme.desc: Quando as primas Krust ridicularizam Jenny por não estar em dia com as tendências da moda, Jeddy pede ajuda a seus amigos.

programme.title: O Clube das Winx
programme.desc: Depois de descobrir que as Winx destruíram o selo do Pilar do Controle, Tritannus procura Politea para roubar seu poder Sirenix e ativar o Trono do Imperador. Icy, Darcy, Stormy e Bloom partem para a montanha submarina.

programme.title: O Clube das Winx
programme.desc: As Winx procuram o Sopro do Oceano no Mundo Ilha para reunir as selkies. Em Gardenia, Tritannus lança um feitiço sobre uma refinaria, provocando chuvas ácidas em Baia Paradiso. As Winx e a Aliança precisam intervir.

programme.title: Familjen Bélier
programme.desc: I familjen Bélier är alla döva förutom 16-åriga Paula, som tar hand om alla utom sig själv. Hon fungerar som sina föräldrars språkrör i deras vardagsliv och är oumbärlig för alla i familjen. Vad hennes föräldrar inte vet är att deras dotter har…

programme.title: Tommy Boy
programme.desc: Tommy har förtjänat sitt diplom och ett jobb på Callahan Auto Parts. Men familjeföretaget börjar gå dåligt, och nu måste Tommy ge sig ut på resa med sin pappas högra hand, en självbelåten siffertuggare.

programme.title: The Bad News Bears
programme.desc: Ett gäng klumpiga, basebollspelande juniorer med en en elvaårig tjej som fuskande kastare, tränas av en komisk, ölpimplande, för detta medioker basebollspelare, som leder dem till mästerskap.

programme.title: Stranger Than Fiction
programme.desc: En skattetjänsteman finner sig vara den ende som hör en berättarröst, en röst vars historia börjar påverka hela hans liv, från arbete till kärlek – och död.

programme.title: Spelets Regler
programme.desc: En man ansluter sig till den politiska kampanjen för en manipulativ kandidat till president i USA.

programme.title: Wild Target
programme.desc: En erfaren lönnmördare får problem när han blir kär i sitt mål, en charmig svindlare som inte tänker gå ner utan en fight.

programme.title: L.A. Gigolo
programme.desc: en unga och charmerande Nicki (Ashton Kutcher) lever ett liv som enbart de snyggaste kan drömma om. Han svindlar till sig en luxuös livsstil genom att tillfredställa rika kvinnor i sängen – och han är djävulskt bra på det!

programme.title: Fantastic Mr. Fox
programme.desc: Animasjonsfilm basert på en historie avnorskættede Roald Dahl. Herr og fru Rev leveret idyllisk liv, men herr Rev begynner å kjennepå sine dyriske instinkter.

programme.title: Epic Movie
programme.desc: To av de forvridde forfatterne av Scary Movie satte nå sine parodiske blikk på den største sjangeren av dem alle: Hollywoods store budsjett, spesialeffektbelastede, blockbuster-franchisefilmer.

programme.title: Dating Amber
programme.desc: Tenåringene Eddie og Amber vokste opp i en liten irsk småby på 1990-tallet. Alle mistenker at de er homofile, og hver dag er en kamp. De kommer sammen på late som og innser at et imaginært forhold kan være minst like komplisert som et ekte

programme.title: Upside of Anger
programme.desc: Da Terry Wolfmeyers (Joan Allen) mann plutselig en dag forlater henne og deres fire døtre uten så mye som et ord til farvel, snus tilværelsen for den vellykkede forstadsfamilien fullstendig på hodet!

programme.title: The Way Way Back
programme.desc: 14 år gamle Duncan sliter med å passe inn i sin nye familesituasjon, med mor, hennes nye, nedlatende kjæreste, og hans datter. Mens moren blir stadig mer fraværende finner Duncan en usannsynlig venn i sjefen på badeanlegget hvor han har sommerjobb.

programme.title: Waiting . . .
programme.desc: Ryan Reynolds, Anna Ferris, og Justin Long serverer latter når unge servitører og servitriser søker etter meningen ved livet, kjærligheten, og vennskap i denne hysteriske komedien.

programme.title: Wild Target
programme.desc: En iskald leiemorder får sitt liv snudd på hodet når han blir forelsket i sitt mål, en sjarmerende svindler med uventede planer.

programme.title: Black Knight
programme.desc: Når en klok svart hustler fra South Central i Los Angeles finner seg transportert tilbake til middelalderens England, leder han styrtingen av en ond konge og vinner hjertet til en protofeministisk kvinne.

programme.title: Mein bester Freund
programme.desc: Der egoistische Antiquitätenhändler Francois lebt nur für seine Arbeit. Selbst in seinem Bekanntenkreis ist man überzeugt, dass er keinen echten Freund hat. Also schließt er mit seiner Kollegin eine Wette ab: Er soll ihr einen besten Freund präsentieren

programme.title: Die Mafiosi-Braut
programme.desc: Michelle Pfeiffer's mob husband is iced by the ruthless Dean Stockwell; so she starts a new life. But Stockwell wants to keep her Married to the Mob.

programme.title: Harold & Kumar
programme.desc: Harold jobbt in einem Büro und wird dort schamlos ausgenutzt. Sein Mitbewohner Kumar schwänzt das Medizinstudium. Hungrig starten sie gemeinsam einen nächtlichen Trip auf der Suche nach Burgern – und erleben ein chaotisches Abenteuer.

programme.title: Eurotrip unzensiert!
programme.desc: Europa wird nie wieder dasselbe sein, nachdem Scotty Thomas und seine Freunde sie im Express zum Exzess mitgenommen haben!

programme.title: Railroad Tigers
programme.desc: Als die japanische Besatzungsmacht 1941 ihr Einflussgebiet über eine militärische Transportlinie in Ostchina ausweitet, schlägt die Stunde einiger rebellischer Bahnarbeiter.

programme.title: Candy & Bonita Make a Porno
programme.desc: Zwei Freundinnen wagen einen humorvollen Vorstoß in die Welt der "Erwachsenenfilme".

programme.title: Hilfe, Ich Komm In Den Himmel
programme.desc: Sonderlieferung für Comedy-Fans! Greg Kinnear spielt die Hauptrolle, Garry Marshall (Pretty Woman) führt Regie. Zusammen liefern die beiden einen heiteren Film über einen Betrüger ab, der vom Tunichtgut zum Gutmenschen wird.

programme.title: Hjælp, jeg ser rødt
programme.desc: Morskaben begynder i Miami, da politiaspiranten Dave Speed spillet af den hysterisk morsomme Terence Hill, sendes ud til et øde sumpområde for at aflevere en bøde. Da han kommer derud, udsættes han ved et uheld for et radioaktivt stof...

programme.title: Delta Farce
programme.desc: Three hapless guys are mistaken for Army Reservists and loaded onto an army plane headed for Iraq and then mistakenly ejected in a Humvee somewhere over Mexico.

programme.title: Jeg hedder stadig Trinity
programme.desc: Verdens populæreste spaghettihelte, Terence Hill og Bud Spencer er denne gang meget mod deres vilje kommet til at optræde som tapre mænd.

programme.title: Megalodon Rising
programme.desc: Da historiens største vandlevende rovdyr vender tilbage, har den armada af moderne krigsskibe, der bliver sendt ud for at dræbe det, ikke en chance.

programme.title: A Breath Of Scandal

programme.title: Animal Treasure
programme.desc: Il corallo rosso è in pericolo e non protetto, mentre quello nero alle Hawaii è tutelato. Il lusso può aiutare la conservazione, a differenza della gioielleria turistica.

programme.title: Animal Treasure
programme.desc: Un tempo cacciato, il Crocodylus Porosus è oggi tutelato grazie a un uso sostenibile nella moda di lusso, che contribuisce alla sua conservazione attraverso pratiche controllate.

programme.title: Animal Treasure
programme.desc: Il muschio di cervo, usato in profumi e medicina, è prezioso ma minaccia la specie. Vietato negli USA, è spesso sostituito da muschio sintetico. La tutela resta scarsa.

programme.title: Animal Treasure
programme.sub-title: Lo storione: il re dei pesci
programme.desc: Il caviale, simbolo di lusso, è minacciato da pesca e inquinamento. Iran, Russia e Kazakistan lo controllano. Solo uno sviluppo sostenibile può salvare storioni e mantenere il caviale raro.

programme.title: Animal Treasure
programme.desc: La vigogna, tra gli animali più preziosi per la sua lana fine, è salva grazie a programmi sostenibili in Perù. La sua lana resta un lusso che ne tutela la sopravvivenza.

programme.title: L'alfabeto degli animali: Farfalle e avocetta
programme.desc: Un mare di fiori profumati nel sole della primavera...Il paradiso è sulla terra per noi farfalle...che aggiungiamo colore al colore! Seguici, e ti raccontiamo il nostro mondo segreto...

programme.title: L'alfabeto degli animali: Struzzo e ghepardo
programme.desc: Occhi grandi, un becco di tutto rispetto, zampe forti per correre. Mi chiamo struzzo e sono l’uccello più grande del mondo! Vivo nelle praterie africane. Per diventare così grosso ho rinunciato a qualcosa: non posso volare. Beh, tutto non si può avere.

programme.title: L'alfabeto degli animali: Cavallo e squalo
programme.desc: Liberi, forti e selvaggi...Noi cavalli ci sentiamo così...anche se ormai non siamo più selvatici. La nostra amicizia con gli esseri umani è cominciata 5000 anni fa e piano piano le razze equine sono diventate domestiche.

programme.title: L'alfabeto degli animali: Rondine e puma
programme.desc: Sono una grande migratrice: in inverno vivo in Africa, ma ogni primavera torno in Europa per nidificare. Mangio mosche, moscerini, zanzare e insetti di ogni tipo. Sono un’animale davvero utile ma i vostri insetticidi ci hanno fatto diventare rare...

programme.title: L'alfabeto degli animali: Gatto, foche e otarie
programme.desc: Da molto tempo i gatti sono amici degli uomini: 5.000 anni, vissuta sotto lo stesso tetto...Nonostante tutto questo tempo non hanno perso però la loro natura selvaggia: sono cacciatori selvaggi, ma anche grandi giocherelloni e amici fidati.

programme.title: L'alfabeto degli animali: Cervo e cavalluccio marino
programme.desc: Amiamo la vita di gruppo e ogni maschio adulto ha un vero e proprio harem: richiama le femmine con un canto forte ma non proprio melodioso che si chiama bramito. Per giorni e giorni i maschi fanno a lotta con le corna per decidere chi è il più forte.

programme.title: L'alfabeto degli animali: Cuccioli e lupo
programme.desc: Sono rimasto 11 mesi nella pancia di mamma, ma ora è venuto il mio turno! Sono appena nato e peso più di 40 chili! Adesso provo ad alzarmi. ooh..Ecco fatto! Voi umani per stare in piedi ci mettete più di un anno, io ho risolto il problema in poche ore!

programme.title: L'alfabeto degli animali: Serpenti, rane e rospi
programme.desc: In quasi tutto il mondo le persone hanno paura di noi. Siamo i serpenti! Alcuni di noi sono velenosi e il nostro aspetto può sembrare minaccioso ma non siamo cattivi. In alcuni paesi africani ci facciamo addirittura ammaestrare! La musica ci incanta...

programme.title: L'alfabeto degli animali: Martin pescatore e volpe
programme.desc: Molti uccelli migrano durante l’inverno verso climi più accoglienti Ma non io! Io ho il mio posto preferito, col mio ruscello e il mio ramo preferito. Sono un martin pescatore: neve, freddo, pioggia e intemperie non mi spaventano, anzi!

programme.title: L'alfabeto degli animali: Polpo e procione
programme.desc: Il polpo è un mollusco davvero speciale! Possiede otto braccia: i tentacoli coperti di ventose, grandi occhi e un sifone per respirare e viaggiare a propulsione, come un vero turbo jet! Se disturbato spruzza una nuvola d’inchiostro per confondere le idee!

programme.title: L'alfabeto degli animali: Pipistrello e orso
programme.desc: Abito nelle caverne e per dormire resto appeso alle zampe. Mi chiudo nelle ali come in un sacco a pelo. Noi pipistrelli dormiamo nel buio delle grotte mentre voi andate a passeggio. Di notte ci mettiamo in moto grazie ai nostri formidabili sensi speciali.

programme.title: L'alfabeto degli animali: Lontra e castoro
programme.desc: Sono la regina del fiume: amo le acque cristalline e vado matta per il pesce. Sono una preziosa indicatrice della purezza e della salute del ruscello, perché dove c’è inquinamento io non so proprio vivere... E per questo che sono diventata così rara.

programme.title: L'alfabeto degli animali: Svasso e seppia
programme.desc: Guardo di qua, guardo di là. Siamo un po’ timidi, ma sei tu che mi piaci! Siamo gli svassi e l’acqua è il nostro elemento. Questo è il primo mattone del nostro nido fatto di erbe. Ti sposerò quando la nostra intesa sarà perfetta… Nel frattempo danziamo!

programme.title: L'alfabeto degli animali: Paguro bernardo e nidi
programme.desc: Sono un tipo strano con questo cappello e gli occhi come due periscopi ma sono un crostaceo, un Paguro Bernardo! Questo fiore trasparente è un animale, Attinia e vive con me. Mi protegge con i suoi tentacoli velenosi. Vieni, andiamo a fare un giro!

programme.title: Supervivencia
programme.desc: Ya sea depredador o presa, no faltan guerreros entre las filas de los animales salvajes.

programme.title: Supervivencia
programme.desc: La carrera de la vida surca los cielos para seguir a algunas de las rapaces más voraces mientras se concentran en sus presas.

programme.title: Supervivencia
programme.desc: La mayoría de los reptiles viven en la tierra, pero las tortugas, los cocodrilos y algunas serpientes viven en el agua. En tierra o en agua, descubramos cómo les va en la Carrera de la Vida.

programme.title: Supervivencia
programme.desc: A menudo parece que los depredadores tienen la ventaja en la carrera de la vida. Pero las presas también tienen un arsenal de estrategias, lo que sugiere que algunas no son tan vulnerables como parecen.

programme.title: Supervivencia
programme.desc: El mundo submarino de peligrosos depredadores con dientes afilados como navajas, venenos terribles y otras armas para temer.

programme.title: Supervivencia
programme.desc: Hay muchas razones por las que los insectos son tan prolíficos, pero la posibilidad de vivir en un rango extremo de temperaturas y ambientes ocupa un lugar destacado en la lista.

programme.title: Supervivencia
programme.desc: La Carrera de la Vida continúa incluso cuando se pone el sol.

programme.title: A Incrível Madagascar
programme.desc: Madagascar é um mundo estranho e único de endemismo biológico incomparável. A quarta ilha mais antiga do mundo e a maior, está isolada há 88 milhões de anos.

programme.title: A Incrível Madagascar

programme.title: A Grande Seca
programme.desc: Muitas espécies chamam de casa o Vale Luangwa da Zâmbia, mas ele tem uma das estações de seca mais difíceis imagináveis ​​- sem chuva por sete meses e temperaturas extremas. No entanto, para alguns animais, a estação seca significa oportunidade.

programme.title: A Grande Seca
programme.desc: É outubro no Vale Luangwa da Zâmbia. A época mais quente e difícil do ano. Mas neste ano as condições da estação seca são exacerbadas por um evento global El Niño ... o Vale está no meio de uma seca.

programme.title: A Grande Seca
programme.desc: As chuvas estão atrasadas. É a época mais brutal do ano. Os bebês que nascem na seca enfrentam a fome. Tudo está desesperado por chuva. Quando chega, é um aguaceiro em escala enorme. Criaturas alienígenas emergem em um mundo diferente.

programme.title: Aventuras no Novo Ártico
programme.desc: Ambientado no vasto reino da neve, no topo do mundo, Aventuras no Novo Ártico é uma aventura real, dos mesmos criadores de A Marcha dos Pingüins.

programme.title: Impérios Animais
programme.desc: Esses impérios viajam em massa em busca de alimento, abrigo ou parceiros.

programme.title: Life Stories

programme.desc: Billy Russell, chanteur bipolaire de Saturne 66, est retrouvé en sous-vêtements sur un échafaudage. Aidan le sauve. Après la mort de Max, partenaire de Billy, Aidan et Daniella découvrent Anne-Lise, l’amour passé de Billy, et leur fils caché.

programme.title: Cracked
programme.desc: À la patinoire, Daniella et Aidan rencontrent Terry Dwyer, ancien joueur violent et indic de Rachel Fenton. Liette et Leo enquêtent sur un suspect de meurtre atteint du syndrome de Fregoli, convaincus qu’un assassin change d’apparence le poursuit.

programme.title: Cracked
programme.desc: Après le suicide de Lindsay, 16 ans, sa mère policière bloque le légiste. Aidan et Daniella découvrent qu’elle était harcelée par Jessica et son clan. Quand Jessica disparaît, ils craignent un lien avec le suicide, révélant la toxicité de la jeune fille.

programme.title: Cracked
programme.desc: Le bureau du Coroner enquête sur l’incident du bus où Aidan a tué un preneur d’otages. Le criminel ayant tué un enfant, la responsabilité d’Aidan est engagée. Le Procureur utilise même ses amis et équipiers contre lui pour le faire condamner.

programme.title: Cracked
programme.desc: L’unité psycho-criminalité collabore avec celle des crimes sexuels pour arrêter le violeur de Riverdale. Une nouvelle victime au mode opératoire atypique complique l’enquête. Aidan souffre de la trahison de Daniella, et Caligra réorganise les équipes.

programme.title: Cracked
programme.desc: Quatre hommes armés font un casse éclair dans une bijouterie, bien renseignés et avec des explosifs rares. Un voleur tire en fuyant. Aidan découvre qu’un vétéran d’Afghanistan lié aux diamants a un alibi, puis piste Pete, un démineur stressé et paralysé.

programme.title: Cracked
programme.desc: Une fillette errante est trouvée après le meurtre d’Oscar Wallace. Les soupçons pèsent sur Elliott Belk, beau-frère au passé trouble. La mort d’un détective privé resserre l’étau. Aidan et Daniella reprennent l’enquête, mais la tension monte.

programme.title: Cracked
programme.desc: Le Dr Clara Malone assiste à un braquage dans une aile sécurisée. Un homme masqué vole des médicaments et prend une otage. Aidan et Clara découvrent qu’il veut sauver sa petite amie. La traque se termine dans un parc d’attractions abandonné.

programme.title: Cracked
programme.desc: Lors d’une fusillade au concert des "The Balconies", Anika Marnay, ex-top model, affirme souffrir d’amnésie liée à l’anxiété. Aidan et Clara enquêtent pour savoir si elle protège le tireur, tandis que des liens avec un trafic de drogue apparaissent.

programme.title: Cracked
programme.desc: Un jeune sans-abri schizophrène est retrouvé égorgé dans une zone boisée, la scène nettoyée et l’arme introuvable. L’enquête plonge dans un monde où les exclus sont exploités. Sa famille, dévastée, cache des secrets essentiels à découvrir.

programme.title: Cracked
programme.desc: Le propriétaire d’un primeur à Kensington Market, victime d’une tentative de meurtre, souffre de prosopagnosie et ne peut identifier son agresseur. L’enquête révèle un ancien enfant soldat et remet en question agresseur, victime et justice.

programme.title: Cracked
programme.desc: Ed Janoski refuse de vendre sa maison à un promoteur. Après une explosion, les voisins deviennent suspects. Victime de menaces, sa maison abîmée, Ed sombre dans la paranoïa. L’unité psycho-crimes doit l’aider à se défendre et démêler le vrai du faux.

programme.title: Cracked
programme.desc: Une femme aborigène est assassinée, un suspect muet retrouvé sur place. Les psycho-crimes doutent et relient l’affaire à d’autres similaires. Un tueur en série rôde. L’équipe doit surmonter barrières linguistiques et lourdeurs administratives.

programme.title: Cracked
programme.desc: Maya Henson, infirmière psychiatrique, est assassinée. Les psycho-crimes découvrent une femme captive 4 ans dans un sous-sol, proche de son ravisseur. Le Dr Malone doit briser leur lien pour aider Aidan à arrêter l’homme avant une nouvelle victime.

programme.title: Cracked
programme.desc: Le syndic de Parkdale, escroc de locataires, est assassiné. Un locataire schizophrène rend l’arme, disant que le diable l’a guidé. Malone découvre la vérité sur ses voix, exposant Clara et Aidan à une menace inhumaine qui bouleversera leur vie.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Gravity
programme.desc: Gravity keeps us on the ground and the planets in their orbits, yet we only notice it when it's not there. In space we cheat gravity; falling just as fast but missing the ground. Now this fundamental universal force is slowly giving up its secrets.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Planet Makers
programme.desc: From the beginnings of our solar system 4.5 billions years ago, there remain many clues to reveal its evolution. Remnant debris, asteroids, and comets are what's left of the building blocks to our celestial neighborhood.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Water Worlds
programme.desc: The key ingredient to life in the universe is water. Until recently we thought Earth was the only place in the solar system to have any water at all. Now that probes are peering around nearby worlds we are finding that is just not the case.

programme.desc: Martin est un adolescent de 16 ans presque normal. En effet, quand il ne va pas au lycée il est agent spécial pour « Le Centre », une organisation secrète chargée de traquer les monstres et les phénomènes paranormaux.

programme.title: Martin Mystère: L'Attaque de la Plante Carnivore
programme.desc: Martin, Diana et Java sont envoyés dans une ville voisine pour examiner les disparitions de plusieurs adolescents.

programme.title: Martin Mystère: La Malédiction du Pirate
programme.desc: Pendant que Martin et l'équipe sont en visite scolaire au Musée de la Marine, Martin s'éclipse du groupe (avec Java à sa suite). Il a hâte d'examiner les objets venant d'un vaisseau légendaire qui fût autrefois commandé par un pirate fantôme en maraude.

programme.title: Martin Mystère: Le Retour du Génie
programme.desc: Lorsque Diana, qui se sent seule parce qu'elle n'a pas eu de rendez-vous avec un garçon depuis longtemps, commence à recevoir des messages d'un admirateur secret, elle est excitée que quelqu'un l'ait en fait remarqué.

programme.title: Martin Mystère: Voyage au Pays de l'Epouvante
programme.desc: Martin est un adolescent de 16 ans presque normal. En effet, quand il ne va pas au lycée il est agent spécial pour « Le Centre », une organisation secrète chargée de traquer les monstres et les phénomènes paranormaux.

programme.title: Martin Mystère: La Fureur du Farfadet
programme.desc: Lorsque Martin reçoit son premier appel sur sa nouvelle installation, "la hotline paranormale", il est totalement gonflé à bloc. Et ce, jusqu'à ce qu'il réalise que la personne ayant besoin d'aide est Marvin!

programme.title: Martin Mystère: La Sérénade Maudite
programme.desc: Martin est un adolescent de 16 ans presque normal. En effet, quand il ne va pas au lycée il est agent spécial pour « Le Centre », une organisation secrète chargée de traquer les monstres et les phénomènes paranormaux.

programme.title: Martin Mystère: L'Envoutement de Martin
programme.desc: Lorsqu'un jour une séduisante fille apparaît à Torrington, Martin est persuadé de la connaître. Il s'avère que Martin connaît en effet cette fille -- son nom est Vivian Michel.

programme.title: Martin Mystère: Terreur à Torrington
programme.desc: Lorsque Martin apprend que son auteur du paranormal favori (penser à: un genre Stephen King, barbu et excentrique) vient dans la ville de Torrington pour signer des autographes pour son livre, il est totalement excité!

programme.title: Secreto de Amor: Episodio 133
programme.desc: Erika llega a la vida de María Clara y Carlos Raúl para perturbar su difícil situación tras declararse como la nueva rival de María Clara y encontrase empecinada en conquistar el amor de Carlos Raúl.

programme.title: Dead End
programme.desc: It is Christmas Eve and the Harringtons take a trip to their in-laws to celebrate the holidays. Taking an unfamiliar shortcut, Mr. Harrington makes the biggest mistake of his life and leads his family down a terror-filled road with no end.

programme.title: The Haunting
programme.desc: In this edge-of-your-seat supernatural thriller featuring Hollywood's hottest stars, a study in fear escalates into a heart-stopping nightmare for a professor and three subjects trapped in a mysterious mansion.

programme.title: Wes Craven Presents: They
programme.desc: Lifelong friends begin experiencing the "night terrors" that plagued them as children, convincing them that a supernatural force is pursuing them.

programme.title: Wes Craven Presents: Dracula 2000
programme.desc: Master of horror Wes Craven presents a sexy, modern-day adaptation of the classic Gothic thriller. After Dracula is awakened from his 100-year slumber, he makes America his first destination, specifically the exotic city of New Orleans.

programme.title: 30 Days of Night
programme.desc: Josh Hartnett (The Black Dahlia, Pearl Harbor) crosses over to the dark side in this bone-chilling adaptation of the cult-hit graphic novel, brought to the screen in all its demonic glory.

programme.title: 30 Days of Night: Dark Days
programme.desc: Almost a year has passed since vampires decimated Barrow, Alaska’s population. Stella, mourning her husband’s murder, has been traveling the world trying to convince others that vampires exist.

programme.title: Let Me In
programme.desc: Owen, an overlooked and bullied boy, finds love and revenge through Abby (Chloë Grace Moretz of KICK-ASS), a beautiful but peculiar girl who turns out to be a vampire.

programme.title: A Última Exorcista
programme.desc: Depois que um estranho acontecimento faz com que todos os padres treinados em exorcismos de uma pequena cidade morram atacados, Joan Campbell deve lutar contra demônios de seu passado que, desta vez, possuíram sua irmã.

programme.title: A Mais Bela de Todas
programme.desc: O Chapeleiro Maluco perseguiu princesas de terras de contos de fadas: Ariel, Bela, Alice, Cinderela, Branca de Neve, Sininho e Aurora, e as fez lutar em uma batalha de morte ao estilo Jogos Vorazes para decidir “Quem é a mais bela de todas?”

programme.title: Circus Kane - O Circo dos Horrores
programme.desc: Um grupo é convidado para um misterioso jogo em uma casa de horrores, sob a promessa de um prêmio de 250,000 dólares para aquele que sobreviver.

programme.title: Incisões Perigosas
programme.desc: A blogueira de beleza Alexa Landry só tinha um medo: a cirurgia plástica. Quando ela é sequestrada com seus amigos pelo Dr. Cunningham, um cirurgião plástico perturbado, obcecado em embelezar suas vítimas, seu maior medo se torna realidade.

programme.title: O Palhaço
programme.desc: Depois de comprar uma boneca, a vida de Lane piora quando amigos próximos e familiares começam a desaparecer.

programme.title: V/H/S
programme.desc: Um grupo de criminosos é contratado para recuperar uma fita de vídeo. À medida que eles buscam em pilhas de fitas VHS o vídeo certo, eles se deparam com um número aparentemente interminável de vídeos assustadores, cada um mais estranho que o último.

programme.title: V/H/S
programme.desc: Em busca da fama na internet, um grupo de adolescentes começa a filmar fenômenos estranhos. Mas eles não sabem que só conseguirão a atenção desejada quando forem protagonistas de acontecimentos sobrenaturais e sangrentos.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone
programme.desc: Millicent Barnes sees her double at a bus terminal.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone
programme.desc: A luckless couple stumbles upon fortune when a genie materializes from a bottle in their antique shop. The genie grants them four wishes but warns them, prophetically, to be careful what you wish for.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone
programme.desc: A three-man spacecraft lands on a planet only to discover the wreckage of a spacecraft identical to their own.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone
programme.desc: Oliver Crangle is a bitter, prejudiced man. Through unknown means, he intends to shrink every evil person in the world at four o'clock.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone
programme.desc: A street salesman cleverly eludes Death. But if he lives, a little girl must die in his place.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone
programme.desc: After successfully stealing a gold shipment, a group of criminals and their scientist accomplice put themselves in suspended animation in a remote desert cave. When they awaken decades later, complications ensue when their truck is destroyed.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone
programme.desc: Actor Rance McGrew makes TV Westerns for a living, but he's a lousy actor and a worse cowboy. Despite that, each week he "wins" against the bad guys. Finally, the bad guys have had enough and decide to teach McGrew a lesson.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone
programme.desc: Martin Sloan, driving through the country, leaves his car and starts to walk toward his hometown, Homewood. He finds things exactly as they were when he was a child. He soon realizes he's gone back in time.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone
programme.desc: Tight fisted Franklin Gibbs is not pleased when his wife wins a trip for two to Las Vegas. But things change when he falls under the spell of a slot machine that calls his name.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone
programme.desc: When three dum-dum crooks get ahold of a camera that takes pictures of the future, they set out to make a quick fortune with their new toy.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone
programme.desc: On the road home from the Civil War, a Confederate soldier stops at a burned-out house and gets to know the owner, a recent widow.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone
programme.desc: Lt. Fitzgerald has found his own special wartime hell. Looking into the faces of his men prior to battle, he has the disquieting ability to see who is about to die.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone
programme.desc: A plane lands safely, but the pilot, crew and all of its passengers are missing!

programme.title: The Twilight Zone
programme.desc: While in the hospital recovering from overwork, Liz Powell keeps dreaming about going down to the hospital morgue.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone
programme.sub-title: Nervous Man in a Four Dollar Room
programme.desc: Small time criminal Jackie Rhoades must face both his past and his conscience while waiting for his next assignment.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone
programme.desc: A has-been, drunk gunslinger finds his fast-draw abilities magically restored.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone
programme.desc: A loud-mouthed braggart's boasts attract the attention of some aliens.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone
programme.desc: When a space exploration crashes on Mars, the surviving passenger is surprised to find that Martians are human-looking, very friendly and apparently just like us...

programme.title: The Twilight Zone
programme.sub-title: The Four of Us are Dying
programme.desc: A man who can change his face to resemble others gets into hot water with gangsters.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone
programme.desc: A scientist arranges to have his human-looking robot pitch for the struggling local baseball team.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone
programme.desc: A widower buys a robot grandmother for his three children.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone
programme.desc: A singer's song becomes tragically real.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone
programme.desc: Riding home on the train one day, a man falls asleep and dreams it is 1880, and he is entering a small town called Willoughby.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone
programme.desc: A man finds that he can trade anything he has, including youth and personality, with anybody else.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone
programme.desc: The senior residents of Sunnyvale decide that the secret to youth is acting young, and in particular playing a childhood game called "kick-the-can."

programme.title: Predestination
programme.desc: For his final assignment, a top temporal agent must pursue the one criminal that has eluded him throughout time. The chase becomes a unique, surprising, and mind-bending exploration of love, fate, identity, and time-travel taboos.

programme.title: The Da Vinci Code
programme.desc: A murder in the Louvre and clues in Da Vinci's paintings lead to the discovery of a religious mystery protected by a secret society for two thousand years -- one that could shake the foundations of Christianity.

programme.title: Angels & Demons
programme.desc: Expert symbologist Robert Langdon (Tom Hanks) follows ancient clues on a heart-racing hunt through Rome to find the four Cardinals kidnapped by the deadly secret society, the Illuminati.

programme.title: Se7en
programme.desc: Gluttony, greed, sloth, envy, wrath, pride, lust—everyone has a sin. Detectives William Somerset and David Mills live among these sins every day. But nothing can prepare them for the killings they're about to experience.

programme.title: Fight Club
programme.desc: A detached man and his friend organize brutal, bare-knuckle boxing matches.

programme.title: Zodiac
programme.desc: Based on Robert Graysmith's books about the real-life notorious Zodiac, a serial killer who terrorized San Francisco with a string of seemingly random murders during the 1960s and 1970s.

programme.title: Totò, Fabrizi e i Giovani d'Oggi
programme.desc: Il cavalier Cocozza e il ragionier D'Amore hanno in comune solo una parlantina inarrestabile e una potente vocazione polemica. I due, acerrimi nemici, negano il consenso alle nozze dei loro figli che le proveranno tutte per riuscire a sposarsi.

programme.title: I due orfanelli
programme.desc: Gaspare e Battista vivono in un collegio di Parigi che accoglie i "figli di nessuno". Quando Il primo scopre di essere il discendente di una nobile e ricca famiglia, parte per cercare i suoi genitori.

programme.title: Totòtruffa '62
programme.desc: Antonio e Felice sono due simpatiche canaglie che, grazie alla capacità di travestirsi, tirano avanti con furti e piccoli raggiri. Il tutto per mantenere Diana, figlia di Antonio, in un lussuoso collegio.

programme.title: Totò, Peppino e le fanatiche
programme.desc: Finiti ingiustamente in manicomio, il ragionier Vignanelli e il cavalier Caprioli raccontano al direttore le folli fissazioni e le manie dei rispettivi familiari. Convinto dalla loro storia, il medico li dimette per ricoverare i veri matti: le famiglie.

programme.title: Totò le Mokò
programme.desc: Totò interpreta un musicista napoletano che scopre di essere l'erede del temibile bandito Pépé e parte per Algeri. Tra equivoci esilaranti, donne affascinate e una lozione miracolosa, trasforma il mito del criminale in un'esilarante avventura.

programme.title: Totò, Peppino e la...Malafemmina
programme.desc: I fratelli Capone sono diametralmente opposti. Peppino lavoratore e risparmiatore, Antonio sfaticato e scialacquone. Devono però unirsi per riportare il nipote, studente di medicina a Napoli, sulla retta via.

programme.title: La banda degli onesti
programme.desc: Tre uomini perbene ma goffi che affrontano difficoltà economiche iniziano con riluttanza a fabbricare banconote false. Il figlio di uno di loro è il poliziotto che segue il caso, ignorando il coinvolgimento del padre.

programme.title: Uccellacci E Uccellini
programme.desc: Totò e Ninetto, vagabondano nella periferia romana per minacciare di sfratto una famiglia che non paga l'affitto. Nel tragitto li segue un corvo parlante, intellettuale e marxista, che racconta le vicende dei frati francescani Ciccillo e Ninetto.

programme.title: WWII's The Great Escapes: The Freedom Trails: France and Spain: The Pyrenees
programme.desc: Monty treks one of the toughest and most famous freedom trails out of Nazi controlled France, taking him through the valleys and high ridges of the Pyrenees mountains and into Spain.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: In Power
programme.desc: Adolf Hitler's secret agenda is to rid Germany of Jews. By 1938, after creating work schemes and rearming, he orchestrates "The Night of Broken Glass," burning 1,000 synagogues and killing 91 Jews, preparing for further aggression.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: Traitor-in-Chief
programme.desc: Pierre Laval, once celebrated and later reviled, faced execution in 1945 for collaboration with the Nazis during Vichy France. Originally a socialist and pacifist, he fell into collaboration for power and to navigate the horrors of occupation.

programme.title: Hitler Uncovering His Fatal Obsession: Barbarossa Unleashed 1941
programme.desc: E1 begins with a brief examination of the rationale of hatred projected by Hitler onto the Soviet-Slavic-Jewish world. Then it leaps forward, to see Hitler initiate an invasion of the USSR.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Aftermath
programme.desc: In WWII's final months, Allies discover Nazi death camps, prompting a sweeping denazification of Germany post-war. Nuremberg trials convict top Nazis. Former Nazis are employed by the West in the Cold War struggle against the Soviet Union.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: End Game
programme.desc: In January 1945, Nazi Germany faces defeat as Allied armies close in. Hitler, aged 55 and in poor health, remains defiant in his Berlin bunker. On April 30th, 1945, Hitler commits suicide, and days later, Germany surrenders, ending World War II.

programme.title: The Real Oppenheimer SV
programme.desc: År 1945 fördes världen in i atomåldern. Med sin roll som bombens fader befäst blev Oppenheimer alltmer oroad över den potentiella fara som vetenskapliga uppfinningar kunde utgöra för mänskligheten.

programme.title: Hitlers Dödspatruller
programme.desc: När Nazityskland invaderade Polen 1939 och Sovjetunionen 1941 följde särskilda insatsgrupper (Einsatzgruppen) i den tyska arméns fotspår.

programme.title: Secret War: The Scholar and the Fight for Greece
programme.sub-title: The Scholar and the Fight for Greece
programme.desc: Monty Woodhouse, a professor and a legend for blowing up the Gorgopotamos Bridge in Greece in 1942. In the British counter attack against Rommell at Al Alamein in North Africa it was vital to disrupt German supply routes, Greece.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Nazis Outfought
programme.desc: By 1944, Hitler's image as a victorious leader is crumbling. He faces a bomb plot led by Stauffenberg and Tresckow, intending to kill him and overthrow the regime. Hitler survives the bombing, triggering a brutal reprisal against conspirators.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Former U.S. Army Ranger Wil Willis tests modern combat shotguns like the Benelli M4 and Mossberg 590, alongside historic models.This documentary features 3D animations and weapon tests to explore effectiveness of combat shotguns.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Weapons That Changed The World examines the RPG-7, renowned for its ability to take on tanks and level buildings. Host Wil Willis traces its evolution from WWII's Bazooka to modern counterparts like the AT-4 and Carl Gustav.

programme.sub-title: El Fox Body Cobra recibe una nueva transmisión
programme.desc: Marc y Tommy evalúan las opciones de transmisión para el Fox Body Cobra.

programme.desc: Marc y Tommy se ponen a trabajar en la restauración del motor y en la suspensión delantera de su Cobra 1981.

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.sub-title: El Dodge Charger del 69 recibe una capa de chapa metálica
programme.desc: Tommy se une a Marc para terminar la chapa del Hard Charger.

programme.title: El Vendedor de Sueños
programme.desc: Un mendigo misterioso salva al psiquiatra Julio César de un intento de suicidio y, presentándose como "El vendedor de sueños", comienza a cautivar a todos con sus profundas reflexiones sobre la vida. Su mensaje se vuelve viral y lo convierte en un influencer insólito, atrayendo a multitudes que buscan sentido en sus palabras sobre la muerte, el perdón, la riqueza y la familia. Pero ¿quién es realmente este hombre enigmático y qué lo trajo hasta aquí?

programme.title: Donde está el Truco
programme.desc: Arturo Maravilla, un joven empresario en crisis, hereda una compañía de teatro circo al borde de la ruina y solo cuenta con el torpe comediante Juanito Sin Blanca. La inesperada muerte de un tío lejano parece ser su salvación, pero en lugar de una herencia, debe hacerse cargo de sus hijos adoptivos, Joel y Rebeca. Todo cambia cuando descubre que Joel, aunque no habla, tiene superpoderes. ¿Podrá Arturo salvar su teatro... y a su nueva familia?

programme.title: Escribir lo Imposible
